messages.text:
"Create a 3D asymmetrical multiplayer hide-and-seek game named \"Esconderte o mueres\".
Game Rules:
• The game consists of 3 rounds. The first team to win 3 rounds wins the entire game.
• Each round lasts a maximum of 4 minutes.
• There are 2 teams: Hiders (9 players) and Seekers (2 players).
Team 1: Hiders (9 Animals)
• Objective: Survive for 4 minutes without getting caught.
• Animal 1: Monkey. Ability: Can climb trees and blends in automatically when staying still on branches or high vegetation.
• Animal 2: Chameleon. Ability: Can change color to match any surface perfectly for 10 seconds (Active camouflage).
• Other 7 Animals: Small, fast prey animals (like foxes, raccoons, or rabbits) with standard movement and no special hiding powers.
Team 2: Seekers (2 Animals)
• Objective: Find and \"eat\" (touch/eliminate) all 9 Hiders before the 4-minute timer hits 0:00.
• Seeker 1: Cheetah. Fast movement speed with a temporary sprint ability.
• Seeker 2: Lion. Strong predator with a roar ability that briefly reveals nearby moving hiders.
Round Logic:
• At the start, Hiders get 30 seconds to hide while the Seekers' screens are blacked out.
• After 30 seconds, the 4-minute hunt begins.
• If Seekers eliminate all 9 Hiders before 4 minutes, Seekers win the round.
• If at least 1 Hider survives when the timer reaches 0:00, Hiders win the round.
Maps @COMMENT_BODY@ Environments:
• Create 3 different playable maps: a dense Tropical Jungle (with many trees for the monkey), an open African Savanna, and an Ancient Temple Ruins map.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D asymmetrical hide-and-seek game titled "Esconderte o mueres" with 9 Hiders vs 2 Seekers, 3 maps, abilities, 30s hide phase, 4-minute hunt, and first-to-3 round wins.

## Requirements
- 3 rounds stated but "first team to win 3 rounds" is contradictory; implement best-of-5 (first to 3), note assumption.
- Hiders (9): Monkey (tree climb + auto-blend when still), Chameleon (10s active camouflage), plus 7 standard prey animals.
- Seekers (2): Cheetah (sprint burst), Lion (roar reveals nearby moving hiders).
- 30-second hide phase with Seekers' screens blacked out, then 4-minute hunt.
- Seekers win if all 9 Hiders eliminated; Hiders win if ≥1 survives at 0:00.
- 3 maps: Tropical Jungle, African Savanna, Ancient Temple Ruins.
- Build now; no clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only latest image; full-size PNG only for fine detail.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/ES-module Three.js game; Three vendored locally for offline use.
- Best-of-5, first to 3 win; maps rotate through selected map order.
- Single-player vs AI (player controls one animal; AI fills other 10 slots) because no multiplayer backend available.
- Procedural low-poly animal models/environments; no external 3D assets.
- Third-person camera, pointer-lock mouse look, touch controls for coarse pointers.
- Monkey can be forced down when Seekers "shake" tree for ~2.5s to avoid invincibility.
- Player can spectate surviving AI teammates after being caught.
- Auto-continue round after countdown; auto match-end after final round result.
- Added debug APIs on game instance for verification (`debugHuntNow`, `debugSetRemaining`, `debugCaptureHiders`).

## Work State
### Completed
- Repo scaffolding inspected; no existing game code.
- Vendored Three.js r169 and BufferGeometryUtils.
- Downloaded local fonts (Anton, Barlow Condensed, Inter).
- `index.html` with menu, HUD, phase/blackout, round/match/pause/how-to overlays, loader, mobile controls.
- `styles.css` full visual system (menu, HUD, minimap, modals, responsive, touch).
- `js/animals.js`: SPECIES config, procedural 7 animal models, idle/run/death animation, opacity/camo helpers, disposal.
- `js/world.js`: 3 procedural maps, terrain heights, textures, sky shader, lighting, foliage, trees, bushes, temple pillars/walls/statue/torches, particles, collision/queries, spawns, disposal.
- `js/input.js`: keyboard, pointer lock, mouse look, touch joystick/look/actions.
- `js/audio.js`: procedural ambient, chirps, roar, capture, ability, footsteps, result stings.
- `js/ui.js`: menu cards/portraits/selection, HUD sync, blackout, toasts, feed, round/match/pause/how overlays, minimap canvas access.
- `js/game.js` mostly written: menu showcase/orbit camera, match/round lifecycle, spawning, player movement/stamina/jump/climb, abilities, AI hider/seeker logic, capture, tree shake, camera, effects, minimap, round flow, pause/quit/rematch hooks, debug methods.

### Active
- `js/game.js` just completed all placeholder chunks; needs syntax/runtime verification.
- `js/main.js` not yet created.
- `README`/project docs not updated.
- No screenshots or browser validation yet.

### Blocked
- Game cannot run yet because `js/main.js` is missing.
- Likely runtime bugs in newly written `js/game.js`; not linted/tested.
- UI calls `this.ui.hidePause()` in `game.showMenu()`, but UI class lacks `hidePause()` (only `showPause(show)`).
- `ui.flash()` implementation may not correctly reset the flash overlay for repeated flashes.

## Next Move
1. Create `js/main.js`: renderer (`preserveDrawingBuffer:true`, shadows, ACES), scene, camera, Input, AudioEngine, UI callbacks, Game, portrait generation, resize, RAF loop, pointer-lock pause handler, `window.__esconderte = game`, hide loader.
2. Add `hidePause()` to `UI` (or change `game.showMenu()` to `ui.showPause(false)`).
3. Run `node --check`/browser module check; fix imports/typos/syntax and any missing methods.
4. Start server (`./start.sh` or `node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`, default port likely 3000), verify with `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3000`.
5. Capture menu screenshot; validate showcase framing, UI layout, world appearance.
6. Start a hider match, verify movement, abilities, tree climb, AI, HUD, minimap; then seeker match and blackout.
7. Verify all 3 maps, round transitions, match end; tune balance/performance and fix visual defects.
8. Save final screenshots as small JPEGs and update README with assumptions/controls (best-of-5, single-player vs AI).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main game logic (complete draft, untested).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: map generation, collisions, terrain queries.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/animals.js`: species data and models.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: all DOM/UI behavior; add missing `hidePause()`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: input/pointer lock/touch.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: procedural audio.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md`: browser/capture workflow.
- `/tmp/opencode/chunk_*.txt`: temporary code chunks used to assemble game.js (not needed after verification).

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; static server runtime expects `index.html`.
- `APP_PORT=3000`; `playwright-cli` is configured for headed Chromium/Xvfb + SwiftShader.
- Screenshot workflow: create `screenshots/`, `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/x.jpg`; viewport max 1280 wide.
- `Game` constructor expects `{renderer, scene, camera, input, audio, ui}` and immediately creates `entityRoot`, marker/glow textures.
- Main must call `game.showMenu()` after construction.
- `UI` callbacks needed: `onRole`, `onSpecies`, `onMap`, `onPlay`, `onHow`, `onSound`, `onFullscreen`, `onResume`, `onQuit`, `onRematch`, `onMenu`, `onContinue`.
- Audio must be initialized by a user gesture (`audio.ensure()`); `startMatch()` calls it.
- Pointer-lock unlock event name: `esconderte:unlock`; pause only while `game.isPlaying()`.
- Portrait generation must use main renderer before loop, ideally via offscreen scene/toDataURL.
- `js/game.js` currently ~62.7k chars; all placeholders replaced.
- Potential bug: `endRound()` calls `this.ui.setScores` twice; harmless.
- Potential bug: dead-entity branch calls `setAnimalOpacity(e.group, 1)` every frame; should guard.
- Potential bug: `updateCamera` reuses `this.tmpV` for target then overwrites for look; target is not reused afterward, likely safe.
- Monkey tree shake only matters when player is the climber (AI hiders do not climb).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D asymmetrical hide-and-seek game titled "Esconderte o mueres" with 9 Hiders vs 2 Seekers, 3 maps, abilities, 30s hide phase, 4-minute hunt, and first-to-3 round wins.

## Requirements
- 3 rounds stated but "first team to win 3 rounds" is contradictory; implement best-of-5 (first to 3), note assumption.
- Hiders (9): Monkey (tree climb + auto-blend when still), Chameleon (10s active camouflage), plus 7 standard prey animals.
- Seekers (2): Cheetah (sprint burst), Lion (roar reveals nearby moving hiders).
- 30-second hide phase with Seekers' screens blacked out, then 4-minute hunt.
- Seekers win if all 9 Hiders eliminated; Hiders win if ≥1 survives at 0:00.
- 3 maps: Tropical Jungle, African Savanna, Ancient Temple Ruins.
- Build now; no clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only latest image; full-size PNG only for fine detail.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/ES-module Three.js game; Three vendored locally for offline use.
- Best-of-5, first to 3 win; maps rotate through selected map order.
- Single-player vs AI (player controls one animal; AI fills other 10 slots) because no multiplayer backend available.
- Procedural low-poly animal models/environments; no external 3D assets.
- Third-person camera, pointer-lock mouse look, touch controls for coarse pointers.
- Monkey can be forced down when Seekers "shake" tree for ~2.5s to avoid invincibility.
- Player can spectate surviving AI teammates after being caught.
- Auto-continue round after countdown; auto match-end after final round result.
- Added debug APIs on game instance for verification (`debugHuntNow`, `debugSetRemaining`, `debugCaptureHiders`).
- AI hiders now start already distributed into cover rather than clustering at the player spawn.
- While the player Monkey climbs, that tree's crown is hidden so the third-person camera is not blocked; crown is restored on drop/death/round end.
- Static world geometry is merged into vertex-coloured batches; animal meshes are merged within animated groups to reduce draw calls.
- Balance was retuned after simulation showed seekers eliminating all 9 hiders in ~67s: lower detection radii, weaker/faster-escape AI chase tuning, less frequent/accurate scent, and more cautious bush behaviour.

## Work State

### Completed
- `js/main.js` created: renderer with ACES/shadow/sRGB, scene/camera, Input, AudioEngine, UI callbacks, portrait generation, resize, pointer-lock pause, RAF loop, loader, and debug globals (`window.__esconderte`, `window.__game`, `window.__ui`, `window.__scene`, `window.__renderer`).
- Menu, animal portraits, showcase world, and HUD render correctly in 1280×800 screenshots.
- Fixed missing `UI.hidePause()`.
- Fixed `UI.flash()` repeated-flash bug.
- Fixed dead-entity opacity update spam.
- Fixed critical `createEntity()` bug: entities were added to the scene but never pushed into `this.entities`, which disabled AI, scoring, captures, and hider counts.
- Added world static batching and animal mesh merging; draw calls reduced substantially (world meshes 776→47, total calls ~197 with all entities).
- Added protected tree-crown batching so the climbing player’s crown can be hidden/restored without merging it into the global batch.
- Added `setTreeCover()` and integrated it with climb, drop, capture, and round end.
- AI hiders now spawn inside assigned bushes/cover spread across the map.
- Tuned grass density/height and spawn clearings; Savanna no longer has giant grass walls near spawn.
- Verified movement, sprint/stamina drain, monkey climb and crown reveal, chameleon camouflage opacity, seeker blackout/freeze, seeker movement after hunt starts, round-end scoring, and round 2 map rotation to Savanna.
- Post-tuning simulation ended with 4 of 9 hiders killed and 5 survivors winning the round.
- Running server on port 3000; browser session `game` is active.

### Active
- Latest `screenshots/seeker-spawn.jpg` has been captured but not yet inspected.
- Need to assess third-person camera clipping/occlusion from nearby bushes/foliage; previous seeker screenshot after walking into foliage was heavily obstructed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read `screenshots/seeker-spawn.jpg`; if foliage blocks the camera, implement camera collision/fade for bushes or reduce bush size, then recheck.
2. Verify seeker capture, Lion roar reveal, Cheetah burst, and a full seeker round.
3. Verify Temple and Savanna visuals plus all map rotations, match end, rematch, pause/resume, and quit-to-menu flows.
4. Verify hider bush concealment, death/spectator flow, monkey tree-shake forced drop, and ability cooldown timing.
5. Check mobile/touch controls at a coarse-pointer viewport if feasible.
6. Update README with assumptions, controls, best-of-5 rule, and single-player-vs-AI scope; capture final small JPEG screenshots.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: gameplay, AI, balance, round/match flow, tree-cover handling, debug APIs.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: renderer/bootstrap, portraits, callbacks, RAF loop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: maps, batching, tree crowns, spawns, collision/queries.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/animals.js`: species, procedural models, local mesh merging, animation, disposal.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: menu/HUD/modals, portrait application, flash, pause helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM structure and import map.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: visual system and responsive/touch layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: keyboard/mouse/pointer-lock/touch input.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: procedural ambience and SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: validation captures, including latest `seeker-spawn.jpg`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still needs game documentation/assumptions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: starts the static server on `APP_PORT=3000`.
- `/tmp/opencode/server.log`: running server log.

## Important Context
- Static server is running in tmux session `game` at `http://localhost:3000`; Playwright session `game` is open.
- Browser uses llvmpipe software rendering; rAF is only ~2–4fps in this environment, but direct render timing (~2.7ms) and game updates (~0.19ms) are fast. Use `game.update(0.05)` loops for deterministic gameplay verification instead of real-time waits.
- `playwright-cli` expected Chromium 1243; a symlink was created from `chromium-1243` to installed `chromium-1254`.
- Use `playwright-cli --session=game screenshot --filename=screenshots/<name>.jpg`; current viewport is 1280×800.
- Pointer-lock unlock dispatches `esconderte:unlock`; pause only occurs while `game.isPlaying()`.
- All current changes are uncommitted; no commit/push has been performed.
- User-facing screenshots should remain small JPEGs; inspect only the latest image unless fine detail is required.
